G_CHECKPOINT_LOAD.evidence: 10 controls/checkpoints loaded; requested and effective hashes compared.
G_CHECKPOINT_LOAD.action: Retain hash verification in every evaluator.

G_CHECKPOINT_SENSITIVITY.evidence: Random/final and controlled-perturbation comparisons use fixed paired worlds.
G_CHECKPOINT_SENSITIVITY.action: Require superiority to random/uniform before SP1 promotion.

G_CACHE_ISOLATION.evidence: Audit cache key includes protocol, trainer, policy, checkpoint, worlds, evaluation, decoder, repair, closure and stage mode.
G_CACHE_ISOLATION.consequence: Audit evaluations cannot alias across checkpoint hashes.
G_CACHE_ISOLATION.action: Adopt the common key in all SP runners.

G_RAW_REPAIR_QR_SEPARATION.evidence: Historical policy executor exposes RAW plus one POLICY_REPAIR result, not immutable RAW/REPAIR/QR tables.
G_RAW_REPAIR_QR_SEPARATION.consequence: Decoder/closure contribution cannot be split into repair and QR retrospectively.
G_RAW_REPAIR_QR_SEPARATION.action: SP1 must persist three separate assignment tables before confirmatory execution.

G_SEED_STATE_CONSISTENCY.evidence: training/status.json says confirmatory_seeds_opened=false while final manifest says confirmatory complete.
G_SEED_STATE_CONSISTENCY.consequence: Historical lifecycle cannot be promoted as internally consistent.
G_SEED_STATE_CONSISTENCY.action: Keep history immutable; use append-only SP_COMMON state events from now on.

G_STATISTICAL_FINITE_RESULTS.evidence: 15 hypothesis rows have non-finite effect/CI; 3 use p=0.
G_STATISTICAL_FINITE_RESULTS.consequence: Affected claims are downgraded to not supported.
G_STATISTICAL_FINITE_RESULTS.action: Implement preregistered fallbacks and interpretable effect scales.

G_FAILURE_TAXONOMY.evidence: Historical rows lack a versioned explicit failure_code; retrospective mapping is not causal proof.
G_FAILURE_TAXONOMY.consequence: The aggregate 8,498 failure/timeout statement is not methodologically adequate.
G_FAILURE_TAXONOMY.action: Emit FailureCode at event time in SP1 and future SPs.

G_REBUILD_FROM_RAW.evidence: No complete simulator-free rebuild entry point or deterministic source-data contract exists.
G_REBUILD_FROM_RAW.action: Implement and test experiment_common.rebuild before SP1 freeze.
